10. (1) There shall be a Chancellor who shall be the Head of the
University and shall preside when present at any Convocation and
shall have such other powers and perform such other duties as may

rules and regulations.

Agong, on the advice of the Minister, for such period not exceeding
seven years, as may be specified by the Yang di-Pertuan Agong.
